POSITION.canonical_name: The Twin at the Year Gate
POSITION.value: Independence was the family lesson, and you took it early. Expect a life where help arrives late and pride arrives first, and you manage anyway.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Twin inside the Year Gate
POSITION.value: Some part of you grew up fast and private, learning to need very little. That toughness holds, though letting people in will always take deliberate effort.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Twin at the Month Gate
POSITION.value: You do your best work as nobody’s junior. Midlife rewards your independence, though shared money with friends will need clearer lines than friendship likes.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Twin inside the Month Gate
POSITION.value: Your prime runs on your own engine: careers built alone hold, careers built on rescue stall. Equity and credit stay cleanest when they are written down early.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Twin inside the Day Gate
POSITION.value: In love you need an equal, someone with a spine that matches yours. Marriage will feel like a partnership of captains, and it works when neither keeps score.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Twin at the Hour Gate
POSITION.value: You will age on your own terms and make it look easy. The young learn self-reliance from watching you, so leave the door open while you stand alone.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Twin inside the Hour Gate
POSITION.value: Your later years run on a few chosen equals, friends who became family. Invest in that small circle now: it is the pension no market touches.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Rival at the Year Gate
POSITION.value: Daring runs in your bloodline and shows early. Money moves fast around you, in and out, so your fortune favors nerve backed by a ledger someone honest keeps.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Rival inside the Year Gate
POSITION.value: You grew up where mine and yours blurred, and it made you generous and watchful at once. Keep sharing on purpose: looseness with money costs you relationships first.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Rival at the Month Gate
POSITION.value: At work you compete the way others breathe, and people feel it. Your career rises fastest in open contests, and slowest wherever the prize must be split.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Rival inside the Month Gate
POSITION.value: Under your working life runs a gambler’s pulse: bold moves feel safer to you than waiting. Midlife pays your courage well once partners stop holding your purse.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Rival inside the Day Gate
POSITION.value: You fall for bold ones, partners with fire and opinions. Home will never be dull, and it stays happy when the money keeps separate lanes.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Rival at the Hour Gate
POSITION.value: You will show the future your nerve: heirs and juniors copy your boldness first. Budget for late generosity, because people will ask, and you will want to say yes.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Rival inside the Hour Gate
POSITION.value: The people who come after you will have your fire and their own ideas. Late in life, generosity is your grace and your leak: give on purpose, not on request.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Artisan at the Year Gate
POSITION.value: Warmth was your first language, learned young and worn openly. Doors open for you through charm and good taste, and they keep opening as long as you keep giving.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Artisan inside the Year Gate
POSITION.value: Somewhere early, someone fed you well, in every sense. That ease still lives underneath you, and providing for others will keep quietly providing for you.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Artisan at the Month Gate
POSITION.value: The working world knows you for the ease of what you make. Your career grows by appetite rather than ambition, and the work you enjoy pays best.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Artisan inside the Month Gate
POSITION.value: Craft sits in your bones: your prime years produce steadily, without drama, and better than louder people. Guard your health and routine, they are your production line.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Artisan inside the Day Gate
POSITION.value: You are built for a warm table and a gentle partner. Marriage feeds you, literally and otherwise, and your best fortune gathers around the home you two keep.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Artisan at the Hour Gate
POSITION.value: What you make late in life may outshine everything before it. Children and students take after your gifts, and your last chapters read sweeter than your first.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Artisan inside the Hour Gate
POSITION.value: Ease deepens as you age: the root of your late years is comfort earned, kept, and shared. Expect a good table, good sleep, and company that stays.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Virtuoso at the Year Gate
POSITION.value: You were the bright one early, the child who outgrew the script. Authority and you started rough, and your luck improves every year you pick your own stage.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Virtuoso inside the Year Gate
POSITION.value: Underneath your story runs an early refusal: some rule at home never fit, and you knew it young. That edge becomes brilliance once it stops needing an audience.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Virtuoso at the Month Gate
POSITION.value: The working world sees your talent before your discipline, and both are real. Careers with a stage suit you, and bosses who need obedience will not keep you.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Virtuoso inside the Month Gate
POSITION.value: Your prime runs on performance: you outdo, outshine, and occasionally overstep. The money follows your gift wherever the format is loose and the spotlight honest.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Virtuoso inside the Day Gate
POSITION.value: You need a partner who applauds, and you notice when they do not. Marriage thrives once the two of you compete with the world instead of each other.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Virtuoso at the Hour Gate
POSITION.value: Your late work will be your boldest, and the young will quote you. Expect gifted, headstrong heirs: they inherit the talent along with the allergy to instruction.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Virtuoso inside the Hour Gate
POSITION.value: The root of your late years is expression that never retires. You will be making, correcting, and dazzling to the end, and it will keep you young.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Horizon at the Year Gate
POSITION.value: Generosity was visible in your beginnings: a family that spent on people and chances. Money finds you through motion and strangers, rarely through sitting still.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Horizon inside the Year Gate
POSITION.value: Somewhere in your roots sits a wanderer, and their restlessness lives in you. Your luck travels: opportunity favors you farther from home than comfort likes.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Horizon at the Month Gate
POSITION.value: The working world reads you as the one who spots the opening. Your career pays in windfalls and timing, so keep a steady hand on the harvests.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Horizon inside the Month Gate
POSITION.value: Under your prime runs a trader’s instinct: you sense value moving before it moves. Trust it in the field, and let someone patient mind the vault.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Horizon inside the Day Gate
POSITION.value: You are drawn to partners with range, people who open doors you would not find alone. Marriage, for you, is also where opportunity walks in.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Horizon at the Hour Gate
POSITION.value: You will stay opportunity’s friend to the end: late ventures, late windfalls, a wide door. Leave the estate mapped, because your generosity will outrun your paperwork.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Horizon inside the Hour Gate
POSITION.value: Your late years keep a wide horizon: travel, ventures, younger company. Fortune stays kind to you as long as something in your life stays in motion.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Steward at the Year Gate
POSITION.value: You learned early what things cost, and it shows in how carefully you build. Money grows for you the slow way, and it starts close to home.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Steward inside the Year Gate
POSITION.value: Thrift is in your roots: a home that counted carefully and wasted little. Your fortune compounds the same way, quietly, and earlier than anyone notices.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Steward at the Month Gate
POSITION.value: The working world trusts you with money and should. Your career rewards stewardship: steady roles, real budgets, value kept. Wealth arrives on schedule rather than by surprise.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Steward inside the Month Gate
POSITION.value: Your prime is built on earned ground: income you can explain, assets you maintain. It grows slower than you would like and further than you expect.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Steward inside the Day Gate
POSITION.value: You are made for steady love: a partner who keeps what you build and builds what you keep. Marriage becomes your most reliable asset, tended like one.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Steward at the Hour Gate
POSITION.value: Whatever the middle years scatter, you end well provided for. What you save builds toward an old age that pays its own way, with something left to hand on.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Steward inside the Hour Gate
POSITION.value: Security deepens with age: the root of your late years is provision done right. Children learn thrift from you, and your estate lands where you intend it.

POSITION.canonical_name: The General at the Year Gate
POSITION.value: Your beginnings carried real pressure, and everyone could see you carrying it. It forged you early. Expect authority to find you young and test you often.

POSITION.canonical_name: The General inside the Year Gate
POSITION.value: Some early weight pressed on you where no one watched, and you turned it into spine. Crisis will always promote you: it is your native ladder.

POSITION.canonical_name: The General at the Month Gate
POSITION.value: The working world reads command on you before you speak. Careers with stakes suit you, and your rank rises fastest where others crack.

POSITION.canonical_name: The General inside the Month Gate
POSITION.value: Your prime runs under pressure by design: you choose hard arenas because ease bores you. Power arrives midlife, through the campaigns nobody else would take.

POSITION.canonical_name: The General inside the Day Gate
POSITION.value: You are drawn to intensity at close range: a partner with force, a home with weather. Love holds when the two of you aim the pressure outward together.

POSITION.canonical_name: The General at the Hour Gate
POSITION.value: You will command to the end, and the young will both fear and follow you. Late authority is yours: soften the orders and the loyalty doubles.

POSITION.canonical_name: The General inside the Hour Gate
POSITION.value: The root of your late years is discipline that never quite retires. Expect standing, respect, and one more campaign than you planned. Keep a gate for rest.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Magistrate at the Year Gate
POSITION.value: You come from order worn openly: a respectable name, early rules, standards met. Reputation is your inheritance, and it keeps paying as long as you keep it clean.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Magistrate inside the Year Gate
POSITION.value: Discipline was the air of your early home, felt more than announced. It gave you a straight spine. Institutions will trust you early and promote you steadily.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Magistrate at the Month Gate
POSITION.value: The working world sees the officer in you: reliable, correct, promotable. Your career climbs by rank and record, and your name will matter more than your salary.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Magistrate inside the Month Gate
POSITION.value: Your prime is built for responsibility: the frame of your working life is duty done properly. Titles find you midlife, and they tend to stick.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Magistrate inside the Day Gate
POSITION.value: You are built for committed love: a principled partner, a household that runs on kept promises. Marriage steadies your whole chart, and it arrives with weight and stays.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Magistrate at the Hour Gate
POSITION.value: Your standing grows with age: honors late, respect that outlives the job. Children measure themselves against your standards, so praise them before you correct them.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Magistrate inside the Hour Gate
POSITION.value: Order is the root of your late years: affairs settled, duties completed, a name in good repair. Your legacy will be trusted, which is rarer than being missed.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Alchemist at the Year Gate
POSITION.value: You were the watchful child, visibly different in how you learned. Your path stays unconventional: the strange skills gathered early become the livelihood nobody predicted.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Alchemist inside the Year Gate
POSITION.value: Your roots hold an unusual nurture: care that came sideways, through books, silence, or an unconventional guardian. Solitude restores you, and always will.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Alchemist at the Month Gate
POSITION.value: The working world sees your odd angle first: the specialist, the diagnostician, the one who reads between. Career luck favors your niche over any ladder.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Alchemist inside the Month Gate
POSITION.value: Your mind works in private, on things most people find strange, and that is exactly where your career luck lives. The niche will pay what the mainstream never will.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Alchemist inside the Day Gate
POSITION.value: You need a partner who respects your inner weather: closeness with breathing space built in. Marriage works as two studies with a shared door.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Alchemist at the Hour Gate
POSITION.value: Late life sharpens your insight instead of dulling it. You will mentor the strange and gifted, and your best ideas may arrive after everyone expects them.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Alchemist inside the Hour Gate
POSITION.value: The root of your late years is the inner library: study, intuition, chosen quiet. Age will suit you, because depth is the one asset that only accrues.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Sage at the Year Gate
POSITION.value: You were sheltered by someone principled, and it shows in your bearing. Learning is your inheritance: credentials, teachers, and timely protection keep appearing across your life.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Sage inside the Year Gate
POSITION.value: Deep in your roots is real nurture, a mother-warmth that took. You default to trust, and life keeps rewarding it with protectors you did not request.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Sage at the Month Gate
POSITION.value: The working world reads you as credible: the one with the knowledge and the calm. Your career advances through reputation and study, and elders open the doors.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Sage inside the Month Gate
POSITION.value: Your prime is carried by learning: the deeper the study, the steadier the rise. Expect your name to rest on what you know, and to age well.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Sage inside the Day Gate
POSITION.value: You are built to be cared for at close range, and to trust it. Marriage brings shelter: a partner whose steadiness becomes your second spine.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Sage at the Hour Gate
POSITION.value: You will end as the elder people consult: knowledge kept warm and given away. Teach deliberately, because your protection of others is what history keeps.

POSITION.canonical_name: The Sage inside the Hour Gate
POSITION.value: The root of your late years is quiet backing: pensions of goodwill, children who shelter you, sleep that comes easily. Kindness banked early pays your old age.
